title: MongoDB as the store for events and baselines
context: Repository events have different forms for commits, merge requests, issues and documents.
decision: Persist the data in MongoDB with 12 declared collection schemas.
consequences: It accepts different event forms without a schema migration. It loses the relational guarantee of referential integrity.

alternatives.rejected_because: The domain does not use the relational guarantee, and the cost of the first modelling would delay SP3 with no verifiable benefit

sensitivity_points: flexibility: new event types are accepted
risks: Without referential integrity, the application must validate the data
